scope: Local merge, integrity verification, report reconciliation, and numerical-boundary review of the split PROSTATEx outer-fold 3 retrieval bundle; no local DICOM decoding or clinical review

exclusions.reason: T2 axial and ADC FrameOfReferenceUID values differ

boundary_reconciliation.interpretation: Numerical boundary noise only. In-plane coordinates are within bounds and the nominal slice coordinate is the final ADC slice center.

conclusion: Fold 3 retrieval completed with one protocol-preserving patient exclusion. The sole reported out-of-bounds finding exceeded the final ADC slice index by only 1.57e-5 voxel (4.70e-5 mm) and is accepted as floating-point boundary noise under a 1e-4-voxel tolerance.
limitations: The archived report retains its original REVIEW_REQUIRED status; the effective status is a documented local reconciliation.
This local reconciliation verifies bundle bytes and recorded geometry but does not repeat pydicom decoding locally.
The result does not establish anatomical registration, image quality, ADC physical units, label correctness, or clinical validity.
next_step: Use the revised 1e-4-voxel boundary tolerance when retrieving and auditing frozen outer fold 4.
